resources.string: Endpoint used in HTTP/2 mode. Leave empty to use 162.159.198.2.
Addresses assigned to this device inside the tunnel, one per line.
PEM public key the endpoint is pinned to.

Ping the connection once it has received nothing for this long, and drop it if the ping goes unanswered. 0 leaves it unchecked, which is fine on a direct path; set it when the tunnel runs through another proxy.

How long the connection may sit idle before it is probed. Each probe wakes the radio; too long, and a carrier NAT may drop the idle connection, delaying incoming notifications until the phone next sends something. 0 turns probing off.
